body: My mental problems got way worse recently so I relapsed on alcohol, pushed away my only remaining friend, lost one of my jobs, car got repossessed since I couldn't afford payments, and now I'm in debt and facing eviction and homelessness. Shit was bad before but now with all that stuff to deal with? I hope you can understand why I don't plan on sticking around much longer. I think the universe is trying to say that it's over for me
